label: HP LaserJet Pro MFP M428fdw
description: HP LaserJet Pro MFP M428fdw is a 40 ppm A4 mono laser multifunction (print, copy, scan, fax) with a 50-sheet ADF, duplex printing and 802.1X-capable networking. Standard connectivity is one RJ45 Gigabit 10/100/1000BASE-T port with 802.3az EEE plus a single dual-band 802.11b/g/n 2.4/5 GHz radio with Wi-Fi Direct, and there is no PoE.
notes: From HP's published specification: Connectivity, standard - '1 Hi-Speed USB 2.0', '1 rear host USB', '1 Front USB port', 'Gigabit Ethernet 10/100/1000BASE-T network', '802.3az(EEE)', '802.11b/g/n/2.4/5 GHZ Wi-Fi radio'; Network capabilities '10/100/1000Base-TX Ethernet, Gigabit; Auto-crossover Ethernet; Authentication via 802.1X'; print speed 40 ppm (42 ppm HP High Speed); 50-sheet ADF. One radio covering two bands, so it is modelled as a single wireless interface - do not expect simultaneous 2.4 and 5 GHz association. USB ports deliberately not modelled. Not confirmed: HP labels the radio 802.11b/g/n rather than ac/ax, and publishes no PHY rate, so 300M is the 802.11n ceiling used as a model figure. This printer is listed discontinued by HP (replaced up the M480/MF400 line); it is included because it is what is still sitting in offices.
